'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Reid Smith DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
